descriptionChirho: The proper noun Kiriathaim, a place name referring to cities in Transjordan (in Moab, associated with Reuben's territory, and in Naphtali for Levites). All four clusters represent the same toponym with slight spelling variations and different morphosyntactic frames (bare noun, with conjunction waw). Arabic consistently renders qiryatayima (قِرْيَتَايِمَ), Spanish shows variants Kiryatayim/Quiriataim, Korean uses kiriadaim (기리아다임/기랴다임), Swahili Kiriathaimu, and Hindi kiryataim (किर्यातैम). The kethib/qere variants in S133415 confirm these are orthographic, not semantic, distinctions.
